name: translation-tool
description: Translation tool from English to Vietnamese using GPT

scripts.electron: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const env = { ...process.env }; delete env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const child = spawn(require('electron'), ['.'], { stdio: 'inherit', env }); child.on('exit', code => process.exit(code ?? 0));"
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k --success first "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run electron"
scripts.electron:build: rm -rf dist && npm run build && electron-builder
